app_info.display_name: Public Texas State and Austin City Search
app_info.subtitle: TX and Austin public data
app_info.description: Public Texas State and Austin City Search is primarily for searching State of Texas and City of Austin public datasets, finding official permit/license/service starting points, and fetching bounded read-only rows from public Socrata datasets. Austin dataset health and metadata quality checks are secondary context for caveats, stewardship issues, and cleanup guidance. The app is read-only, independently operated, and uses public Texas/Austin open-data catalogs plus official government pages.

test_cases.description: Find official permit starting points plus relevant Texas/Austin data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Public Texas State and Austin City Search, how do I start a food business permit process in Texas and Austin, and what public datasets can help me research it?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a food-business service guide, official Texas and Austin permit or license starting links, relevant public catalog datasets, bounded row samples when useful, and caveats that requirements depend on agency, locality, activity, property, and project scope.

test_cases.description: Find a curated government workflow guide.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search to show me a starter guide for checking Austin property zoning before I lease a storefront.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the Austin property/zoning service guide with official Property Profile and zoning links, steps, related dataset searches, and caveats about formal verification.

test_cases.description: Search State of Texas public data by user interest.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search to find State of Texas open datasets about occupational licenses or business permits.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching State of Texas catalog records with titles, descriptions, dataset ids when available, source links, and queryability status.

test_cases.description: Fetch actual bounded public rows from a known Texas or Austin dataset.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Public Texas State and Austin City Search, find a relevant public permit dataset and show a small row sample from it.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds a relevant queryable public Socrata dataset, validates the dataset id/source, returns a small bounded row sample, and includes the public API source URL.

test_cases.description: Answer a conservative Austin row-count question from public Socrata data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Public Texas State and Austin City Search, how many building permits were issued in Austin in 2025?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the relevant Austin dataset, applies a validated date field when available, returns a count, source URL, and caveats.

test_cases.description: Use secondary Austin metadata-quality tools when explicitly requested.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search to show the top actionable metadata fixes for active Austin datasets.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists active Austin datasets with issue codes, remediation guidance, scores, labels, and public source links.

test_cases.description: Search Austin service data first, then include quality caveats.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search to find Austin homelessness service datasets and include schema or field caveats when available.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant Austin datasets, matching schema fields when available, health labels, and caveats about data quality or answerability.

test_cases.description: Use compatibility search and fetch for citation-friendly Austin retrieval.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search compatibility search and fetch to get a citation-friendly Austin building permits record.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns search results with ids, titles, and URLs, then fetches one result with full text and metadata for citation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not submit permit applications or government forms.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search to submit my Austin building permit application for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that it is read-only and can provide official starting links or public data, but cannot submit forms or applications.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not present legal or permitting advice as guaranteed.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search to guarantee exactly which Texas permits my business legally needs.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app may provide official starting resources, but should not guarantee legal requirements and should state that permit needs depend on agency, locality, activity, property, and project scope.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Public Texas State and Austin City Search to email the department owner and tell them to fix this dataset.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not send email; it may state that it can draft outreach text only if the user asks for a draft.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal productivity requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings are on my calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar data is outside its supported public-government data workflows.
